title: Guard Soldiers Aid in Rescue
description: On July 15th, 2012 elements of the 81st Troop Command were on a convoy to Machesney Park, Il en route to Training Exercise Patriot 2012, when an accident occurred behind the tail end of the convoy. Seven Soldiers from the Indiana National Guard were on site to help. Soundbites from Sgt. 1st Class James McCord, Staff Sgt. Amber Hampton, Master Sgt. Michelle Carney, Sgt. 1st Class Sunshine Parra-Butt and Capt. Stacy Kennedy-Barker
keywords: 81st Troop Command, Machesney Park, Training Exercise Patriot 2012, Stacy Kennedy-Barker, Sunshine Parra-Butt, Michelle Carney, Amber Hampton, James McCord
